pairs: Baltassar rex fecit grande convivium optimatibus suis mille:
Belshazzar, the king, made a great feast for a thousand of his nobles,
et unusquisque secundum suam bibebat ætatem.
and each one of them drank according to his age.
Præcepit ergo jam temulentus ut afferrentur vasa aurea et argentea,
And so, when they were drunk, he instructed that the vessels of gold and silver should be brought,
quæ asportaverat Nabuchodonosor pater ejus de templo,
which Nebuchadnezzar, his father, had carried away from the temple,
so that the king, and his nobles,
Then the gold and silver vessels were presented,
which he had carried away from the temple and which had been in Jerusalem,
et laudabant deos suos aureos et argenteos, æreos,
and they praised their gods of gold, and silver,
In the same hour, there appeared fingers,
quasi manus hominis scribentis contra candelabrum in superficie parietis aulæ regiæ:
as of the hand of a man, writing on the surface of the wall, opposite the candlestick,
et rex aspiciebat articulos manus scribentis.
in the king’s palace. And the king observed the part of the hand that wrote.
Then the king’s countenance was changed,
et genua ejus ad se invicem collidebantur.
and his knees knocked against one other.
Exclamavit itaque rex fortiter ut introducerent magos,
And the king cried out loudly for them to bring in the astrologers,
Et proloquens rex ait sapientibus Babylonis:
And the king proclaimed to the wise men of Babylon,
et interpretationem ejus manifestam mihi fecerit,
and make known to me its interpretation will be clothed with purple,
et torquem auream habebit in collo,
and will have a golden chain on his neck,
et tertius in regno meo erit.
and will be third in my kingdom.”
Tunc ingressi omnes sapientes regis non potuerunt nec scripturam legere,
Then, in came all the wise men of the king, but they could neither read the writing,
nor reveal the interpretation to the king.
Unde rex Baltassar satis conturbatus est,
and even his nobles were disturbed.
because of what had happened to the king and his nobles,
Do not let your thoughts confuse you,
neither should your face be altered.
There is a man in your kingdom,
qui spiritum deorum sanctorum habet in se,
who has the spirit of the holy gods within himself,
et in diebus patris tui scientia
and in the days of your father,
et sapientia inventæ sunt in eo:
knowledge and wisdom were found in him.
et rex Nabuchodonosor pater tuus principem magorum,
appointed him leader of the astrologers,
and understanding, and interpretation of dreams,
ac solutio ligatorum inventæ sunt in eo,
and the solution to difficulties were found in him,
to whom the king gave the name Belteshazzar. Now,
and he will explain the interpretation.”
Igitur introductus est Daniel coram rege:
Then Daniel was brought in before the king.
And the king spoke to him, saying,
Tu es Daniel de filiis captivitatis Judæ,
“Are you Daniel, of the sons of the captivity of Judah,
quem adduxit pater meus rex de Judæa?
whom my father the king led out of Judea?
that you have the spirit of the gods,
as well as understanding and wisdom,
ac sapientia ampliores inventæ sunt in te.
Et nunc introgressi sunt in conspectu meo sapientes magi,
And now the wise astrologers have entered into my presence,
so as to read this writing
and to reveal to me its interpretation.
et nequiverunt sensum hujus sermonis edicere.
And they were not able to tell me the meaning of this writing.
I have heard about you that you can interpret obscure things and solve difficulties.
if you succeed in reading the writing,
you will be clothed with purple,
et torquem auream circa collum tuum habebis,
and you will have a chain of gold around your neck,
et tertius in regno meo princeps eris.
and you will be the third leader in my kingdom.”
Ad quæ respondens Daniel, ait coram rege:
To this Daniel responded by saying directly to the king,
et dona domus tuæ alteri da:
and the gifts of your house you may give to another,
but I will read to you the writing,
and I will reveal to you its interpretation.
the Most High God gave to Nebuchadnezzar,
et honorem dedit Nabuchodonosor patri tuo.
Et propter magnificentiam, quam dederat ei,
And because of the greatness that he gave to him,
tribus, et linguæ tremebant, et metuebant eum:
and languages trembled and were afraid of him.
Quando autem elevatum est cor ejus,
But when his heart was lifted up
et spiritus illius obfirmatus est ad superbiam,
and his spirit was hardened in arrogance,
depositus est de solio regni sui,
he was deposed from the throne of his kingdom
and his glory was taken away.
et a filiis hominum ejectus est,
And he was expelled from the sons of men,
sed et cor ejus cum bestiis positum est,
and so his heart was placed with the beasts,
et cum onagris erat habitatio ejus:
and his dwelling was with the wild donkeys,
and he ate hay like an ox,
et rore cæli corpus ejus infectum est,
and his body was drenched with the dew of heaven,
donec cognosceret quod potestatem haberet Altissimus in regno hominum,
until he realized that the Most High holds power over the kingdom of men,
though you knew all these things.
sed adversum Dominatorem cæli elevatus es:
But you have lifted yourself up against the Lord of heaven.
et vasa domus ejus allata sunt coram te,
And the vessels of his house have been presented before you.
et concubinæ tuæ vinum bibistis in eis:
you have praised the gods of silver,
qui habet flatum tuum in manu sua,
yet you have not glorified the God who holds your breath
and all your ways in his hand.
Idcirco ab eo missus est articulus manus,
Therefore, he has sent the part of the hand which has written this,
quæ scripsit hoc quod exaratum est.
Hæc est autem scriptura, quæ digesta est:
But this is the writing that has been decreed:
And this is the interpretation of the words.
you have been weighed on the scales
and has been given to the Medes
et circumdata est torques aurea collo ejus:
and a chain of gold was placed around his neck,
et prædicatum est de eo quod haberet potestatem tertius in regno suo.
and it was proclaimed of him that he held power as the third in the kingdom.
Eadem nocte interfectus est Baltassar rex Chaldæus.
That same night, king Belshazzar the Chaldean was killed.
Et Darius Medus successit in regnum,
And Darius the Mede succeeded to the kingdom,
at the age of sixty-two years.
